title: Source (v1)
description: Schema for library/sources/<source_id>.json, describing an external system this library reads from or reconciles against. Never contains secrets, API keys, session tokens, account IDs, or private endpoints — those live in device-local, untracked configuration, referenced only by source id.

contract.description: Shape of the integration contract. "openapi" is preferred where a stable spec exists (e.g. RomM); "export-file" covers Playnite-style file exports; "scrape" and "manual" are last resorts and always plan/staging-first.

endpoint_ref.description: Sanitized, non-secret reference to where the contract is documented or configured (e.g. a doc anchor or environment variable name) — never a literal URL, IP, or hostname bound to a private deployment.

capabilities.description: What this source can be used for.

stability.description: Confidence in the contract's durability. Sources without a stable contract (kind in epic/ea/ubisoft today) are "inventory"-only capability and stability "best-effort" or "unsupported" until a stable contract exists.
